stemMd: All blue labels are waterproof. No waterproof labels dissolve in the test. Which conclusion must hold?

options.label: E
options.textMd: No blue labels dissolve in the test.

explanationMd: Blue labels are inside the waterproof class, which is excluded from the dissolving class. Therefore blue labels cannot dissolve. This conclusion does not require that any blue labels actually exist.

distractorRationale.b: No rule governs every non-blue label.
distractorRationale.d: The premises do not establish that absence.
